declarations.reason: The run's yard dressing, pickups and barricades are regenerated every run from the zone catalog and run seed, and they move or vanish with the compactor, so they stay runtime-owned. The static silhouette is authored: editor.scene.json places the water-tower crowns, one landmark cluster per yard, crane-leg pylons at each yard seam and the alternating shoulder sentries (scripts/author-corridor.ts), all outside the fenced driving line.
